g.text: Tylioji Sutartis · the Silent Pact of 1345
Sworn on Vėlinės night in the Šventaragis valley. Three parties, three clauses, and a bill that outlives the oath.
They give: Lithuania will not be
conquered. The Order may raid and
burn, but never hold the heartland.
Algirdas and Kęstutis, the Krivis as
witness. Iron on a stone, true names
whispered to the fire, blood on a
Every spirit of place stands witness,
the laumės as surety. The dvasios
the baptised and the unborn are
Green: kept · Red: broken or ended · Gold: paid, fulfilled in secret, or a remnant
THE UNBINDING (Atsaistymas): how the Pact's protection runs out
Before 1382 the spirits keep custom. After 1387 they are owed nothing and give nothing: swamps eat trackers, groves breed ravenous vėlės, aitvarai turn arsonists.
The baptism saves Lithuania from the Order and damns it to its own unfed dead. Neither choice was clean.
